messages:
maya_sec: Heads-up we keep getting unclear asks to unwrap archived logs. can we define a fast path for triage without opening full raw exports?
raj_infra: yep. idea: short-lived unwrap tokens via kms-proxy, only for archive-checkpoint API, and ticket-gated.
oliver_sre: defaults: 4h token, max 8h with second approver. no silent renewals. audit-bot logs every unwrap.
tess_analyst: for vuln triage 4h is usually enough. prefer masked fields (no payload blobs).
liam_privacy: must whitelist fields returned: ts, event_type, user_id(hashed), service, short_msg. legal ok with that if exported data is minimized.
maya_sec: add guardrails: >3 unwraps in 30d -> auto-escalate; off-hours unwraps alert sec oncall.
raj_infra: infra will add CLI `archive-request` to create ticket and call kms-proxy. policy will bind `analyst_view_temp` with condition request.source=="ticketing-bot".
oliver_sre: monitoring: alert on large reads, multiple users on same checkpoint, and unusual time patterns.
audit-bot: [audit] unwrap requested by tess_analyst checkpoint=cp-2023-11-09 duration=4h ticket=SEC-6991
maya_sec: I'll draft the short playbook and ticket template. raj/oliver/tess please review.
